title: Mithral Ore
summary: One ore makes one Adamantine item at the forge. Only two ore pieces are available per playthrough.

fields.Craft: Load 1 Mithral Ore into the crucible and the chosen mould into the mould chamber. Lower the platform, release lava, then activate the forge lever. Each item consumes 1 ore.
fields.Outputs: Adamantine Longsword, Mace, Scimitar, Shield, Scale Mail, or Splint Armour. Match the mould to the desired item.
fields.Acquisition: Mine the two veins in the Abandoned Refuge at approximately X −556, Y 277 and X −642, Y 253.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
